items.title: Russian strike reportedly hits Kharkiv machine-tool factory
items.summary: A Russian military correspondent reported two strikes about five minutes apart on workshops at the Harverst machine-tool factory at 277 Heroiv Kharkova Avenue in Kharkiv. The report did not provide a damage or casualty assessment.

items.title: Ukrainian drones reportedly attack central Luhansk
items.summary: Local reports cited by a Donbas news outlet say Ukrainian drones were attacking central Luhansk. The account did not specify targets, damage or casualties.
